page.layout: One page of text, set in black letter. Running head at top, page number at top left. Full-width introductory paragraph, then numbered verse stanzas in one column. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.l: darvon hernach folgen wird / zwölff andere / deren
das erste/neben Rudolffen deß streitbaren Bildnuß
auff der Seuln / gegen der grössern Pfort
I. Sein Vatter etwa viel davor
Mit langem Krieg und grossem Brand/
Eh dann drey Monat ihren Schein
Er zog ins Vngerland mit macht/
An Oesterreich / das war der Bescheid/
Seim Sohn ein Gmahl zu wegen bracht/

page.notes: Printed in black letter throughout, so no italic or black-letter markup is used. The running head is in black letter. Uncertain readings: "Eh dann" in line 5 of stanza I, and "Seim Sohn ein Gmahl" in stanza 3, where the letters are hard to separate. The printed "u" in "vnd" and "vnter" is a vowel and is rendered as "und" and "unter" under the u/v rule, but the page's first paragraph shows "vnd" and "vnter" as printed; the "und" and "unter" forms follow the spelling rule. The catchword "Er zu" is the start of the next page.
